question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **'****Historigraphy'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The list of words provided includes 'Periphery', 'Fractural', 'Antagonistic', and 'Historigraphy'.
 
• The last word **'Historigraphy'** is incorrectly spelled.
 
• The correct spelling of the term is** 'Historiography',** which refers to the study of the methodologies of historians in developing history as an academic discipline (इतिहास-लेखन).
 
 
• **Example: **His dissertation explored the historiography of Medieval Europe.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 4'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Periphery':** It is spelt correctly and means the outermost part or boundary (परिधि). 
 
• **'Fractural':** This word does not exist in English dictionaries. It seems to be a misspelling but was not the answer in this instance. 
 
• **'Antagonistic': **It is spelt correctly and in Hindi, it means प्रतिद्वंद्वी/ विरोधी.
